description: What a Base wallet bought, sold and moved lately — its token + ETH moves newest first (time, in/out, token, amount, USD value, counterparty, tx, swap flag), a per-token in/out/net table sorted by net USD, newly picked-up tokens, USD in/out totals, swap count and top 5 counterparties. Facts only — this is not investment advice, a price target, or a buy/sell/hold signal. 404/free if no moves in the window; 503/free if the chain read is down. Costs $0.02 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
name: wallet_activity
